section.catchline: Mailing notice of delinquency or publication of delinquent list -- Contents -- Notice -- Definitions.
section.subsection:
The county treasurer shall provide notice of delinquency in the payment of property taxes and tax notice charges:
except as provided in Subsection (5), on or before December 31 of each calendar year; and in a manner described in Subsection (3).

The notice described in Subsection (2) shall be provided by:
mailing a written notice that includes the information described in Subsection (4)(a), postage prepaid, to:
each delinquent taxpayer; and if the delinquent property taxes or tax notice charges are assessed on a base parcel, the record owner of each subdivided lot; and making available to the public a list of delinquencies in the payment of property taxes:
by electronic means; and that includes the information required by Subsection (4)(b); or publishing a list of delinquencies in the payment of property taxes and tax notice charges: in one issue of a newspaper having general circulation in the county; that lists each delinquency in alphabetical order by:
the last name of the delinquent taxpayer; or if the delinquent taxpayer is a business entity, the name of the business entity; and that includes the information described in Subsection (4)(b).

Notwithstanding Subsection (2)(a), if the county legislative body extends the property tax due date under Subsection 59-2-1332(1), the notice of delinquency described in Subsection (2) shall be provided on or before January 10.

subsection.subsection:
In addition to the notice of delinquency required by Subsection (2), a county treasurer may in accordance with this Subsection (6) mail a notice that property taxes are delinquent: to:
a delinquent taxpayer; an owner of record of the delinquent property; any other interested party that requests notice; or a combination of Subsections (6)(a)(i)(A) through (C); and at any time that the county treasurer considers appropriate.

A notice mailed in accordance with this Subsection (6): shall include the information required by Subsection (4)(a); and may include any information that the county treasurer finds is useful to the owner of record of the delinquent property in determining:
the status of taxes and tax notice charges owed on the delinquent property; any penalty that is owed on the delinquent property; any interest charged under Section 59-2-1331 on the delinquent property; or any related matters concerning the delinquent property.
